text_block_list.text:
At Mr. C.B.'s suggestion, we decided to 
stop by the aquarium.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—How nostalgic. It brings back memories 
of that day.”
choice_data_list:
Do you have some fond memories or 
something?

Do you have some fond memories or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't know if I'd call it a fond 
memory, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—You know, I once tried to destroy every 
aquarium in the world. Really.”

text_block_list.name: Young CB
text_block_list.text:
(—The little fishies... are so pretty. 
But... I feel sorry for them.)

text_block_list.name: Young CB
text_block_list.text:
(It was so cramped. I couldn't escape. And 
I didn't understand why... I even had to 
be there.)

text_block_list.name: Young CB
text_block_list.text: (...I'll save you.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—There is only one way: destroy the 
aquarium.
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you being a bit too reckless?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I begged my parents to bring me to the 
aquarium once more to brainstorm a 
strategy."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And I told them honestly that I wanted to 
tear this place down. When I did—

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
—I suppose so... CB. Though about that 
mother and child orca... Do they really 
look that unhappy to you?

text_block_list.name: Young CB
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. But... you look so 
cramped!"

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, maybe so. But... I'm with my 
family. In a safe place."

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Yet out in the wider world, things 
don't work like that. You might be 
together in the morning, only to be 
separated forever by nightfall.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there are times one desires 
freedom. However... brandishing "freedom" 
by force without even knowing the answer 
to that――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—That it was no different from forcing a 
"lack of freedom" upon them.
choice_data_list:
...Must have been quite a shock for a 
child.

...Must have been quite a shock for a 
child.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I cried. A whole lot.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Because I was about to do the very thing 
I hate most in the world myself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Because of that, I started 
thinking things through properly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Wondering what "freedom" really means.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I'm thinking about it. 
Constantly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. Can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Suppose, for instance, Trainer was a sea 
creature. And you knew that if they got 
caught, they'd be brought right here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Dangerous freedom or safe constraint... 
Which one do you think you'd choose?
choice_data_list: A safe lack of freedom... huh.
A safe lack of freedom, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Dangerous freedom or safe constraint... 
Which one do you think you'd choose?
choice_data_list: A safe lack of freedom... huh.
A safe lack of freedom, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice. Being able to swim endlessly 
in the wide-open sea.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Think about it like that, and any thought 
of danger might just fly right out of your 
head.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still... maybe that isn't really 'a lack 
of freedom' after all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
For example, living each day knowing that 
the person precious to you will still be 
by your side tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's just another form of freedom.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's nice to talk about things like 
this once in a while.
choice_data_list:
By the way, what's your own answer to 
that?
By the way, what is your own answer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Well, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —I'll tell you about it again someday.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright then. Maybe I'll buy some 
souvenirs before heading home.

And so, Mr. C.B. chose souvenirs for her 
parents this time as well.

—The prize chosen was a plushie of an orca 
parent and calf. It was meant to convey 
the message that the question from that 
day was still remembered.
